channel.description: Recent content in Visuals on HK Oxalis Portfolio Website

item.title: Innsmouth Marine Biology
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: An horror mystery game made in Godot in 7 days in a group of three people. The code part was a pretty simple data-driven tree file structure, but I designed the UI for the fictional OS #, which I’m proud of.

item.title: Stop-Motion Doll Design
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: I designed, 3D printed and sewed a doll to make a stop-motion animation

item.title: Black Hole Billiards
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: An arcade-style game made in Godot in 4 days. I made all the visuals in shaders, which you can see in my main breakdown article. I’m happy with the gameplay too. One of my better jam results.

item.title: Cosmic shaders for the GMTK game jam
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: For the GMTK game jam 2025, I made a gravity-themed billiards game in Godot, with all art made procedurally with shaders

item.title: Wood-cut markmaking for a turn-based rpg
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: Again using the OpenUSD Python API, I created a script to generate 3d printable models from images

item.title: Lichen Pattern Simulation
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: I used the C++ OpenFrameworks library to create a lichen visual simulation, following a scientific paper

item.title: Applying palettes to images with shaders
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: I wrote a shader using GLSL to align the colours in an image to a palette

item.title: Dithering shader
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A quick glsl dithering shader live in browser

item.title: Still Life In Two Dimensions
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A creepy puzzle game made alongside a composer using Unity in 10 days. The puzzles were a bit too hard, but I like the visual effect of the pressed flowers.
